pred_sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name
raw_response:
SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name
FROM STUDENTS s
JOIN STUDENT_ENROLMENT se ON s.student_id = se.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, se.semester_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT se.degree_program_id) = 2;

question: Find the semester when both Master students and Bachelor students got enrolled in.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'
pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.SEMESTER_NAME
raw_response:
SELECT DISTINCT s.SEMESTER_NAME
FROM SEMESTERS s
JOIN STUDENT_ENROLMENT se ON s.SEMESTER_ID = se.SEMESTER_ID
JOIN STUDENTS st ON se.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID
JOIN DEGREE_PROGRAMS dp ON st.DEGREE_PROGRAM_ID = dp.DEGREE_PROGRAM_ID
WHERE dp.DEGREE_LEVEL IN ('Master', 'Bachelor')
GROUP BY s.SEMESTER_ID, s.SEMESTER_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dp.DEGREE_LEVEL) = 2;

question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
gold_sql: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
pred_sql: SELECT p.name
raw_response:
SELECT p.name 
FROM PROPERTIES p 
JOIN REF_PROPERTY_TYPES rpt ON p.property_type_id = rpt.id 
WHERE rpt.name IN ('house', 'apartment') 
AND p.rooms > 1;
